svg.text: Every indexing, scoring and graph algorithm that ships today — where it runs, what it computes, and which are on by default.
1 - INGEST: EACH DOCUMENT BECOMES STATISTICS, NEVER TEXT
ingest and query share one module
e.g. RF-{n}, matched on the text:
tf per field, in this order:
A ref edge carries its link
into the target at read time
Regex on the doc's own text:
both reach ranking ONLY as a
256 shards, shard = blake2b(id, 1 byte). One canonical JSONL line per document (sorted keys, no floats, no nulls, NFC). Postings: term hash → per-field tf vector.
A committed per-document byte is a function of that document alone. Everything corpus-wide — df, n, avg_wlen, anchor terms, the abbr table — is a read-time fold.
2 - DERIVED PLANE: fux build, GITIGNORED, REBUILT FROM THE SHARDS ALONE
Postings grouped into blocks. A 62-byte binary offset table
holds each block's max weighted tf (mx) and min wlen (mnw):
an exact per-block score ceiling, read without the block.
Law: results byte-identical to the scan.
Proven by tools/differential/, not hoped for.
Communities on the undirected edge graph (Raghavan 2007).
No randomness: visit sorted(nodes), ties → smallest label,
≤ 20 sweeps, stop when a sweep changes nothing.
Renamed c0, c1 … by size, then smallest member id,
so a label names the partition, not the traversal.
Union of every record's (long form, ABBR) pairs,
The scan rebuilds the same table from the shards,
Edges are copied into graph.json too — speed only.
3 - fux ask: THE QUERY PIPELINE, TOP TO BOTTOM
Same analyzer v3 + identifier families → the REQUIRED hashes. Expansion stacks extra hashes at a lower weight: --expand (agent-written, × 0.2) and mined abbreviations (× 0.5).
B2 byte prefilter: each shard line is read as raw bytes and
json.loads'd only if a query hash appears as a substring.
df, n and avg_wlen fall out of the SAME pass — never stored.
Answers a fresh clone with no build step.
When the two disagree, this one is right by definition.
Terms opened rarest-first. After each term, the k-th score θ
is exact. If Σ (deferred terms' block ceilings) cannot reach θ,
every unopened block is skipped — block-max pruning.
Rounding-aware: skip only if round(bound,9) < round(θ,9).
Generates candidates + statistics only. Never scores, never sorts.
③ BM25F — rank(), the one scorer both paths call
wtf = Σf wf·tff (+ anchor·tf_anchor) score = Σt idf(t) · wtf·(k1+1) / (wtf + k1·(1 − b + b·wlen/avg_wlen))
Weight-then-saturate ONCE — never per-field BM25 summed. k1 1.2 · b 0.15 · body 1 · heading 3 · title 2 · path 1.5 · ctx 1 · anchor 1
wlen = Σ wf·flenf at query time. One Weighting for both paths: intent prior × 1.1 when the doc type matches the question's cue; [priority].
Sort key (−round(score,9), superseded, −mtime, −priority, id) — total and machine-independent. Equal rounded scores are flagged tie.
Top 20, scored by each doc's BEST passage: coverage² × 0.55 + minimum span × 0.30 + bigram adjacency × 0.15. Re-orders, never retrieves.
A human-pinned doc for this exact question moves to #1 AFTER ranking. Never a score.
⑥ graph compose — lazy PPR + RRF
Seeds = the lexical window. Lazy personalised PageRank over ref edges only: damping 0.85, laziness 0.5, 3 fixed iterations, 1 hop, weight = grade.
Tier A: re-order the window by RRF(lexical rank, PPR rank) = Σ 1/(60 + rank). The BM25F score is kept; the row says boosted and shows its route.
Tier B: walked docs holding NONE of the query's hashes → a labelled related list (≤ 5). Never scored, never in the band.
coverage = idf-weighted share of query terms the corpus holds · separation = (s1 − s2) / s1 · support = result count · verified
none: nothing scored · partial: a term matches no doc, or cited bytes changed · weak / grounded: separation against floor 0.1
weak is a signal, not a refusal. missing names every absent term — the field an agent should read first.
Also at query time: -q fuses several questions by RRF (k = 60), and score becomes an RRF score. Matched headings are a display-only pick from phrases.
4 - fux answer: RANK LIKE ASK (TOP 3), THEN RE-SCORE THE FETCHED BYTES
the passage set's own df and n.
5 - GRAPH VERBS AND INSPECTION: READ-ONLY, OUTSIDE ask's RANKING
computed on the fly by fux serve
NOT IN THE ENGINE — SO DO NOT LOOK FOR THEM
Deleted: the dense/embedding lane and its score fusion (2026-08-25) · recency, superseded and archived multipliers (W-151, W-152) · RM3 — failed twice, code removed (W-224).
Stopped at the pre-registration gate: SDM proximity, MMR, section units. A separate exact-identifier field was never built — families replaced it. Git authority prior: ruled, not built.
Drawn from src/fux/query/, derive/, graph/, ingest/, refer/, inspect/ and templates/tune.toml.txt defaults, 2026-09-29. SR-ASK · SR-TUNE · SR-CONFIDENCE · SR-GRAPH · SR-T1-ACCELERATOR.
